label: trimethylamine N-oxide respiration
definition: An anaerobic respiration in which an organism uses trimethylamine N-oxide as the terminal electron acceptor and reduces it to trimethylamine to conserve energy.
observations: Trimethylamine-N-oxide-to-trimethylamine respiratory branch for anaerobic energy conservation; distinct from the narrower TorA trimethylamine N-oxide reductase enzyme system.
